cases.name: Kayla Dezaray Hensley
cases.about: Kayla had Cerebral Palsy and was deaf. Her mother said, "She was the best thing that ever happen to me and will be missed by so many. She is and will always be my Hero. ‘She has overcome many downfalls in life. She was born with CP and was told she would never walk, she walked. ‘She was born deaf, and had cochlear implants and was able to hear. If anyone told her she couldn’t, she made sure to prove them wrong. She was an amazing girl!
